sky cinema comedy.title: Roxanne
sky cinema comedy.desc: Update of the `Cyrano de Bergerac' story about a long-nosed fire chief who falls in love with a beautiful astronomer. The chief is too ashamed of his appearance to make advances himself but is drawn into assisting his rival, a dull but handsome visiting fireman, from behind the scenes as his chances of love are hampered by his lack of confidence.

sky cinema comedy.title: Zoolander 2
sky cinema comedy.desc: A special agent recruits former models Derek Zoolander and Hansel to save the world's most beautiful people from a deadly plot.

sky cinema comedy.title: My Dead Friend Zoe
sky cinema comedy.desc: Stuck in a bizarre relationship with her dead, wisecracking Army pal, a veteran reunites with her solitary grandfather at his lake house.

sky cinema comedy.title: Panda Plan
sky cinema comedy.desc: An action movie star must protect baby pandas from a group of mercenaries.

sky cinema comedy.title: Panda Plan 2: The Magical Tribe
sky cinema comedy.desc: Jackie Chan and panda Hu Hu stumble upon a hidden jungle society that hails the panda as a "divine beast." Jackie must face a group of tribal warriors to protect his panda friend and uncover the ancient secrets of the mysterious land.

sky cinema comedy.title: Anchorman 2: The Legend Continues
sky cinema comedy.desc: Ron Burgundy tries to stay classy when he and his team take New York and the nation's first 24-hour global cable news network by storm.

sky cinema comedy.title: American Pie 2
sky cinema comedy.desc: Action-packed sequel in which a group of friends are reunited after their freshman year of college and embark upon a series of comical adventures when they rent a summer house on Lake Michigan.

sky cinema comedy.title: Bean: The Ultimate Disaster Movie
sky cinema comedy.desc: Mr Bean has somehow managed to get a job as a security guard. His latest assignment finds him travelling to America as an art expert, looking after the famous `Whistler's Mother' painting as it is transported from Britain to a posh new Los Angeles museum. The catch is that Bean is no art expert and his trip was a ploy by his British employers to get rid of him. Unfortunately, no one has warned the Americans about Mr Bean.

sky cinema comedy.title: Mr Bean's Holiday
sky cinema comedy.desc: Mr Bean is going on holiday to the south of France, looking for a quiet and sunny trip in the Riviera. However, his trip doesn't go as smoothly as he expected when he has to face a series of misunderstandings and totally unfortunate coincidences. Eventually, Mr Bean will end up spoiling the last film of the snobbish director Carson Clay and appearing by accident at the Cannes Film Festival.

sky cinema comedy.title: American Pie: The Wedding
sky cinema comedy.desc: Jim and Michelle are getting married and Jim struggles to win over his future in-laws and deal with his embarrassing dad. Meanwhile, Stifler isn't invited to the ceremony, but he's determined not to be left out.

sky cinema comedy.title: Team America: World Police
sky cinema comedy.desc: A gung-ho, `Thunderbirds'-style squad of puppets lead America's war on terrorism. The creators of `South Park' go on the offensive with an outrageous animated satire that makes a target of everyone from politicians to Hollywood liberals.

sky cinema comedy.title: Dumb and Dumberer: When Harry Met Lloyd
sky cinema comedy.desc: A grant-greedy principal puts two clueless teens in a bogus class for students with special needs.

sky cinema comedy.title: Panda Plan
sky cinema comedy.desc: An action movie star must protect baby pandas from a group of mercenaries.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: M3GAN 2.0
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: A military-grade robotic weapon known as Amelia becomes increasingly self-aware and dangerous to the human race. Hoping to stop it, Gemma, an advocate for oversight of AI, decides to resurrect M3GAN, making it faster, stronger, and more lethal.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Chappie
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: Outside influences affect the way the world's first thinking, feeling robot lives and behaves.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Die Alone
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: A young man with amnesia bands together with a rugged survivalist after a devastating virus causes a zombie-like outbreak.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Oblivion
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: Two weeks before he is scheduled to depart from devastated planet Earth forever, a drone repairman rescues a woman from a downed spaceship, triggering a final battle to save mankind.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: The Chronicles of Riddick
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: Outlaw Riddick, on the request of the peacemakers, lands on planet New Mecca and comes face to face with the army of Necromongers who are threatening all planets in their path. Their leader, Lord Marshal, wishes to convert all humans to his beliefs, or kill them.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Nosferatu
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: A new bride is left under the care of friends when her husband travels to Transylvania for a meeting with Count Orlok. Plagued by horrific visions and an increasing sense of dread, she soon encounters an evil force that's far beyond her control.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Sinners
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: Trying to leave their troubled lives behind, twin brothers return to their Mississippi hometown to start again, only to discover that an even greater evil is waiting to welcome them back.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: The Exorcist
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: A famous actress calls upon medical science for help when her daughter begins behaving strangely, but without any success. Then, as bizarre and horrific incidents involving the daughter increase, her mother turns in desperation to the Church, and to a priest who doubts his own faith.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Constantine
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: Supernatural tale based on the cult comic book `Hellblazer'. Chain-smoking loner Constantine tries to buy his place in heaven by banishing earth-bound demons back to hell, but his fate is tied up with Angela, a policewoman investigating the alleged suicide of her twin.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Evil Dead Rise
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: A woman finds herself in a fight for her life when an ancient book gives birth to bloodthirsty demons that run amok in a Los Angeles apartment building.

sky cinema thriller.title: Dirty Harry
sky cinema thriller.desc: A violent and uncompromising police officer hunts for a psychopath who holds the city of San Francisco to ransom. Although the officer's unorthodox methods do not endear him to his superiors, the mayor reluctantly agrees that Harry Callahan seems to be the right cop for the job.

sky cinema thriller.title: The Girl on the Train
sky cinema thriller.desc: A divorced train commuter passes the house she used to live in with her husband every day. To distract herself she creates a fictional perfect world for her former neighbours in her head. This is ruined when one of the neighbours goes missing.

sky cinema thriller.title: Hungry
sky cinema thriller.desc: After becoming lost in the Louisiana swamplands, a group of holidaymakers must fight for their lives against a rampaging hippo on the loose.

sky cinema thriller.title: Jason Bourne
sky cinema thriller.desc: Living off the grid for 10 years, former CIA operative Jason Bourne finds himself back in action battling a sinister network that utilises terror and technology to maintain unchecked power.

sky cinema thriller.title: Civil War
sky cinema thriller.desc: In a dystopian future America, a team of military-embedded journalists races against time to reach Washington, D.C., before rebel factions descend upon the White House.

sky cinema thriller.title: The Bourne Identity
sky cinema thriller.desc: An amnesiac is rescued at sea by the crew of an Italian fishing boat. Nearly dead, he carries nothing but the bullets in his back and the bank account number embedded in his hip. Although completely without identity or background, he possesses an array of extraordinary talents in fighting, linguistics and self-defence that speak of a dangerous past.

sky cinema thriller.title: The Perfect Storm
sky cinema thriller.desc: Seafaring drama based on the true story of a commercial fishing boat crew who become caught in a terrifying storm off the coast of Massachusetts. In the autumn of 1991, a fishing boat captain is determined to set sail despite the adverse weather conditions, but when the ice machine breaks down his decision to brave the storm rather than lose his catch results in a battle against 100ft waves.

sky cinema thriller.title: Hungry
sky cinema thriller.desc: After becoming lost in the Louisiana swamplands, a group of holidaymakers must fight for their lives against a rampaging hippo on the loose.

sky cinema thriller.title: Seven
sky cinema thriller.desc: Two detectives are in search of a serial killer who seems to be exacting retribution for the seven deadly sins. In his final week on the force, veteran Detective William Somerset is drawn back into the decay of the city as he and Detective David Mills, his cocky replacement, hunt the maniac.

sky cinema thriller.title: Along Came a Spider
sky cinema thriller.desc: A detective and a Secret Service agent investigate the abduction of a senator's daughter from a school.

sky cinema thriller.title: Juror #2
sky cinema thriller.desc: A juror for a high-profile murder trial finds himself struggling with a serious moral dilemma that could influence the verdict and potentially convict, or free, the accused killer.

sky cinema thriller.title: Murder by Numbers
sky cinema thriller.desc: A troubled female cop must unravel the perfect murder as she matches wits with two homicidal schoolboys, who believe they can't be caught after committing a motiveless crime. As she gets ever closer to the truth she at once alienates her new partner and puts her own life in peril.

sky cinema greats.title: The Hunt for Red October
sky cinema greats.desc: Soviet and American forces give chase when the captain of a Soviet nuclear submarine sets a course for the Maine coast.

sky cinema greats.title: Dog Day Afternoon
sky cinema greats.desc: A desperate and crazed man, with the help of an accomplice, takes a local Brooklyn bank hostage with plans to rob it in order to pay for his lover's sex-change operation.

sky cinema greats.title: Clear and Present Danger
sky cinema greats.desc: Investigating the assassination of a friend of the President, CIA agent Ryan discovers that his friend was in league with the Colombian drugs cartels. In revenge, a paramilitary force is sent in to wipe out the drug lords but when the operation goes wrong, they're abandoned by their country. Now their only hope is Ryan and fellow renegade operative Clark.

sky cinema greats.title: The Big Heat
sky cinema greats.desc: An honest policeman is determined to bust police corruption and the stranglehold of the Mafia. At first he innocently begins investigating the Mafia-related killing of a fellow officer, but things turn nasty when his wife is killed in a car bomb blast meant for him, his child is threatened with kidnapping and he loses his job.

sky cinema greats.title: First Blood
sky cinema greats.desc: Brooding Vietnam veteran John J Rambo is pushed too far by the sheriff of a small American town. After being wrongfully arrested, the former Green Beret escapes and leads lawmen and an army detachment on a cat-and-mouse chase through the mountains.

sky cinema greats.title: Rambo: First Blood Part II
sky cinema greats.desc: War veteran John Rambo takes on the entire Vietnamese army, plus Soviet advisers, when he is released from prison and is sent back to present-day Vietnam in search of American POWs still being held by the Communists.

sky cinema greats.title: Jaws
sky cinema greats.desc: Scary chiller about a coastal community plagued by a killer shark. With the summer tourist season at hand, the mayor is keen to keep the first attack hushed up. However, when an expert claims that the attacks are the work of a giant great white shark, there is only one solution - to kill the monster fish before it can feed again.

sky cinema greats.title: Jaws 2
sky cinema greats.desc: Another great white shark arrives to terrorise the holiday resort of Amity Island. Having recovered from the grisly events of four years ago, the island is once again packed with tourists. Families are sailing in the bay and swimming off the beach, but when two divers and a water-skier go missing, the local police chief fears that he is about to relive his greatest nightmare.

sky cinema greats.title: Jaws III
sky cinema greats.desc: Second sequel to Steven Spielberg's 1970s blockbuster transports the action from Amity Island to a new undersea kingdom attraction in a Florida theme park. The capture of a baby great white shark is big news and brings crowds to the park - until its mother arrives on the scene.

sky cinema greats.title: Basic Instinct
sky cinema greats.desc: Detective Nick Curran is charged with finding out the truth after Catherine Tramell, a sensual bisexual writer, is suspected of murdering her lover with an ice pick, exactly the method used in one of her books. Unfortunately, he becomes too closely involved.

sky cinema greats.title: Clear and Present Danger
sky cinema greats.desc: Investigating the assassination of a friend of the President, CIA agent Ryan discovers that his friend was in league with the Colombian drugs cartels. In revenge, a paramilitary force is sent in to wipe out the drug lords but when the operation goes wrong, they're abandoned by their country. Now their only hope is Ryan and fellow renegade operative Clark.

sky cinema drama.title: Song Sung Blue
sky cinema drama.desc: Two down-on-their-luck performers form a Neil Diamond tribute band, proving it's never too late to find love and follow your dreams.

sky cinema drama.title: About Time
sky cinema drama.desc: After discovering that he can travel through time, a young man uses his ability to win the woman of his dreams and save his friend from professional disaster.

sky cinema drama.title: True Grit
sky cinema drama.desc: When her father is murdered, young 14-year-old girl Mattie Ross hires grizzled US Marshal Rooster Cogburn to track down the killer into hostile Indian territory. Based on Charles Portis' novel.

sky cinema drama.title: Rocketman
sky cinema drama.desc: Set to his most beloved songs, it's the epic musical story of Elton John, his breakthrough years in the 1970s and his fantastical transformation from shy piano prodigy to international superstar and pop icon.

sky cinema drama.title: May December
sky cinema drama.desc: Twenty years after their notorious tabloid romance, a married couple buckle under the pressure when a Hollywood actress meets them to do research for a film about their past.

sky cinema drama.title: Cast Away
sky cinema drama.desc: Following a man's bid for survival on a desert island following a plane crash. An employee of Fedex snatches a few days between flights with his loving family and fiancée, to whom he proposes, before rushing off on his next assignment. However, his plane crashes during a storm and over the next four years he must train himself to survive away from civilisation.

sky cinema drama.title: Regretting You
sky cinema drama.desc: When a devastating accident reveals a shocking betrayal, Morgan Grant and her daughter, Clara, explore what's left behind as they confront family secrets, redefine love, and rediscover each other.

sky cinema drama.title: Song Sung Blue
sky cinema drama.desc: Two down-on-their-luck performers form a Neil Diamond tribute band, proving it's never too late to find love and follow your dreams.

sky cinema drama.title: Grease
sky cinema drama.desc: High-spirited musical set in 1950s America, in which a girl and boy who met on the beach are unexpectedly reunited at high school. She cannot understand how different he has become. Can the leather-clad, tough-talking leader of the T-Birds really be the same person? Perhaps her new friends, the Pink Ladies, can help her win back his heart?

sky cinema drama.title: Grease 2
sky cinema drama.desc: When Rydell new boy Michael meets hot Pink Lady Stephanie he is instantly smitten, but Michael's a geek and top T-Bird Johnny wants Stephanie back. Will an image change help him get the girl?
